Final research materials accompanying the IEEE Access submission of
“Endpoint Definitions and Label Provenance in Honey-Bee Toxicity Benchmarking”.

Download all four Research ZIP assets and extract them into one directory.
The archives contain 710 distinct current research files. The 15 core analysis
scripts 00–14, datasets, final figures, saved model outputs and restored models
are unchanged. Internal manuscript/code/layout checks, obsolete figure drafts
and previews are excluded; production entry points and documentation are
updated for the resulting package layout.

Each asset is rebuilt from this repository snapshot and published only after
its size and SHA-256 exactly match the corresponding submission attachment.
RELEASE_README.txt gives setup, environment, execution, output, licensing and
contact information; RESEARCH_ARCHIVE_SHA256SUMS.txt lists archive hashes.

No experiments or model fits were rerun for this packaging update. The earlier
release remains available as a historical snapshot; this is the final package
linked by the current manuscript.
